result.summary: Several layout and content issues: restaurant names and category chips are clipped, a promo badge shows a nonsensical “-0%”, and a bottom card is cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in “Fastest near you” (Trattoria Piccol…) is cropped so the name and image are cut off at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding or allow the row to scroll fully so the last card is fully visible.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza) is cut off by the tab bar, hiding the restaurant name, rating, and delivery details.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/safe-area inset so cards scroll fully above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a “-0%” badge, which looks like a broken or empty discount.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when there is no real discount, or show a meaningful offer.

issues.description: The category chips row is clipped on the right (Healthy is cut off and the next chip is only a sliver).
issues.suggestion: Ensure the last visible chip isn’t truncated and that overflow scrolling is obvious.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the “Fastest near you” row wrap or truncate inconsistently (e.g. “Trattoria Piccol”).
issues.suggestion: Use consistent truncation (ellipsis) or allow two lines so names stay readable.
